notes: Prompts mix triggering tests (casual CodeLens UI phrasings) and output-quality tests (OKLCH token system, single severity source of truth with color+shape, Tailwind v4 wiring, the token-driven inline diff table, the separate risk token family, accessibility). Assertions are objectively checkable.

evals.prompt: Style the CodeLens severity badge for critical, warning, and suggestion.
evals.expected_output: A SeverityBadge that reads from a single SEVERITY_STYLES map using OKLCH severity tokens (var(--severity-*)), and conveys severity with a shape/label in addition to color (e.g. a dot + the word).

assertions.text: Maps all three severities from a single source-of-truth object, not ad-hoc per component
Uses the --severity-* CSS variable tokens rather than hardcoded hex/rgb
Conveys severity with color AND a non-color cue (shape or text label)

evals.prompt: Set up theming and dark mode for the CodeLens app.
evals.expected_output: OKLCH CSS variables defined fully in :root and .dark, Tailwind v4 wiring with @custom-variant dark and an @theme inline mapping so bg-card etc. resolve, plus the severity and diff-chrome tokens.

assertions.text: Defines colors in OKLCH, not HSL/hex
Declares the full token set in both :root and .dark
Uses Tailwind v4 syntax: @custom-variant dark and @theme inline (no tailwind.config.js darkMode)
Does NOT introduce a v3 tailwind.config.js darkMode: 'class' setup

evals.prompt: Build the CodeLens inline comment component that shows a blinking cursor while its text is still streaming and settles when done.
evals.expected_output: A Card-based component with a severity-colored left border via var(--severity-*), the SeverityBadge, optional confidence, and an animated cursor shown only while isStreaming is true.

assertions.text: Shows an animated cursor only while the comment isStreaming
Colors the accent/border from a --severity-* token
Reuses SeverityBadge rather than re-implementing severity styling

evals.prompt: Lay out the CodeLens PR review page with the diff on one side and a comment rail on the other.
evals.expected_output: A Tabs layout (Diff/Summary/Comments) with a grid giving the diff the dominant minmax(0,1fr) column and a fixed-width comment rail, each in a ScrollArea; the diff is the project's own table styled from the --diff-* tokens with findings rendered inline under their line.

assertions.text: Uses shadcn Tabs and a grid with the diff dominant and a fixed-width rail
Renders the diff as a token-styled table (no third-party diff viewer) with inline comment rows
Wraps long scrollable regions in ScrollArea

evals.prompt: Make the CodeLens dashboard: stat cards and a chart of findings by severity.
evals.expected_output: A responsive Card grid of StatsCards plus a SeverityChart whose segments use the severity tokens and are labeled (not color-only), keeping WCAG-considerate contrast in both themes.

assertions.text: Uses a responsive shadcn Card grid for the stats
Colors chart segments from the --severity-* tokens and labels them (not color alone)

evals.prompt: Add a risk badge to the CodeLens PR list and a risk chart to the dashboard. It should look clearly different from the comment severity badges.
evals.expected_output: A --risk-high/--risk-medium/--risk-low OKLCH token family in :root and .dark (separate hues from severity), a RISK_STYLES single source of truth, a RiskBadge pairing color with a bar glyph + label + score and a neutral 'Not scored' state, and a chart colored from the same map.

assertions.text: Defines separate --risk-* tokens rather than reusing --severity-* tokens
Defines the risk tokens for both light (:root) and dark (.dark)
Uses one RISK_STYLES-style map consumed by both the badge and the chart
Conveys risk with a shape/label in addition to color

evals.prompt: Style the thumbs up/down and the 'apply suggestion' button on a CodeLens AI comment.
evals.expected_output: Ghost icon buttons with counts and aria-pressed state (active vote highlighted with accent tokens), an outline 'Apply suggestion' button with pending spinner and an 'Applied' outline link state, all token-driven and keyboard accessible.

assertions.text: Exposes vote state via aria-pressed (not color only)
Shows distinct idle / pending / applied states for the apply action
Uses shadcn Button variants and theme tokens, no hardcoded colors
